# OpenSocrates 1.3.1

This patch fixes the packaged one-shot decision command: pretty-printed JSON
now reaches the native selector as one complete, bounded document. Persistent
`--stream` input keeps its newline-delimited JSON contract.

- The native release gate runs the packaged example and checks selection and
  repeated stream requests.
- Concurrent lifecycle inspectors converge on one validated blocked receipt.
- Release publication checks GitHub platform immutability and exact public bytes;
  npm publication requires the matching immutable GitHub release.
- English and Korean documentation distinguishes package validation, in-request
  native observations, submission hooks, Desktop GUI and cloud activation.
- All 48 methods and 96 authored EN/KO procedure bodies remain unchanged.

```sh
npx --yes opensocrates@1.3.1 install --host all
# Existing installations:
npx --yes opensocrates@1.3.1 update --host all
```

Native runtimes target Apple-silicon macOS. Package checks do not establish
live host delivery or actual method application. Desktop GUI, separate-Mac
installation, signing/notarization and Claude Chat cloud activation remain
unvalidated. No quality, latency, naturalness or token-cost improvement is claimed.
Historical P11 retains its 300-second deadline and 384.58-second final delivery.

The v1.3.0 tag and assets are preserved. This is a new patch release.
